title: Quick lemon chicken salad
summary: Quick lemon chicken salad is a middle eastern dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and little gem lettuce, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Quick lemon chicken salad chopped before the pan goes on. Pat skinless chicken breast fillets dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook skinless chicken breast fillets until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook little gem lettuce and radishes until hot and lightly browned. Return skinless chicken breast fillets and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Quick lemon chicken salad, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
steps.tip: Taste Quick lemon chicken salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
